metadata.description: Agent skills for writing C# browser automation and tests with Dramaturge, and for driving a browser with its command-line tool.

plugins.name: dramaturge
plugins.description: Skills that teach coding agents to write reliable C# browser automation and tests with Dramaturge (launching browsers, user-facing locators, auto-waiting actions, retrying Expect assertions, and routes) and to drive a live browser from the shell with the dramaturge tool's sessions, exporting what was done as a test.
